backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing comment list management with customer-facing functions (getAvailableCommentLists, generateSingleComment, generateBulkComments) and admin functions for creating, uploading, locking, and deleting comment lists with role-based authorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining CommentList and Comment types with a run function that passes through the old actor state unchanged for canister upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features for wiring the Create button, displaying loading states, and validating list ID input in AdminCommentsTab component.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including pages for comment generation, admin panels, authentication gates, and UI components with their specific functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining CSS variables for light and dark themes including background, foreground, primary, secondary, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the React application titled 'APP REVIEW'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring React Query, theme provider, and TanStack Router with routes for customer view, upload section, live list checker, and admin panel with token gate protection.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminChatT: Admin UI component for managing chat messages with form inputs for sender/message and a history display. Uses custom hooks to fetch all messages and add new ones with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminComme: Admin UI component for managing comment lists with features to create lists, add comments (bulk or single), delete comments, lock/unlock lists, and reset/delete lists. Includes comprehensive state management and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminImage: Admin UI component for viewing and deleting uploaded rating images in a grid layout. Displays image thumbnails with uploader name, timestamp, and delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLiveL: Admin UI component for managing live list apps and their associated usernames. Supports creating apps, adding usernames in bulk or comma-separated format, and resetting/deleting apps.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSetti: Admin UI component for managing the bulk generator access key. Displays current key status with masked value and provides functionality to set or reset the key.
frontend/src/components/AdminTokenGate.t: Authorization guard component that checks admin token validity and displays access denied message or loading state before rendering protected admin content.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackdrop: Empty component file for canvas-based animated background with floating hearts and sparkles.
Empty component file for glassmorphism-styled audio player with playback controls.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Empty component file for authentication and authorization wrapper for admin pages.
frontend/src/components/EffectBurst.tsx: Empty component file for visual effects like heart explosions and confetti bursts.
frontend/src/components/GalleryGrid.tsx: Empty component file for responsive gallery grid with hover animations.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Empty component file for Internet Identity login/logout button with cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/Rotating3DObject: Component rendering a 3D rotating cube with six colored faces using CSS transforms.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Empty component file for footer with copyright and Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Root layout component with fixed background image, top segmented navigation, main content outlet, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution and UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/SiteNav.tsx: Empty component file for responsive navigation with conditional admin access.
frontend/src/components/TeddyMascot.tsx: Empty component file for animated teddy bear mascot with breathing and jump states.
Sticky navigation bar with icon-labeled buttons for Customer View, Upload Section, Live List Checker, and conditionally-rendered Admin Panel based on admin token validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Initializes access control with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminComments.ts: React Query hooks for admin comment list management including fetching lists, creating lists, adding/removing comments, bulk operations, and locking/unlocking lists with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminToken.ts: Custom hook for admin authentication that checks URL hash and session storage for a hardcoded admin token, providing admin status and access control.
frontend/src/hooks/useBulkGeneratorKey.t: React Query hooks for managing bulk generator API key including checking key status, setting new keys, and resetting keys with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useChatMessages.ts: React Query hooks for fetching all chat messages and adding new chat messages with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: React Query hooks for comment generation including fetching available lists, generating single/bulk comments with device tracking, and handling various error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication providing login/logout functionality, identity management, and authentication status tracking using DFINITY AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListChecker.ts: React Query hooks for managing live list apps and checking usernames against them, including admin operations for adding/deleting apps and managing usernames.
frontend/src/hooks/useRatingImages.ts: React Query hooks for managing rating images including uploading, fetching all images, and deleting images by index with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark themes, pastel color schemes, utility classes for cards/buttons, and 3D rotating cube animations.
frontend/src/lib/deviceId.ts: Provides utilities for generating and storing a stable device identifier in localStorage, and tracking which comment lists have been used for single-generation on the current device.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabbed interface for managing comments, images, chat, live lists, and settings with gradient UI styling.
frontend/src/pages/CustomerViewPage.tsx: Customer-facing page for generating single or bulk comments from selected lists, with device-based single-generation restrictions and admin access code entry.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListCheckerPage.t: Page for checking usernames against selected live list apps, with localStorage persistence for form data and results, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSectionPage.tsx: Page for uploading rating images with uploader name, featuring progress tracking and success feedback using ExternalBlob for file handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system, custom container settings, extended theme with design tokens, and plugins for animations and typography.
project_state.json: Project state tracking an admin panel application with comment list and live event/app management features. Currently fixing bugs where create buttons for both comment lists and live lists are not wired to backend functions.
